description: The explorer's search: finds addresses, tokens (by name or symbol), contracts, transactions and blocks matching a query, such as "pepe", a hash or an address. Returns each match's type, name, symbol, address or hash and whether a contract is verified. Names, symbols, tags and method names are set by whoever deployed or verified a contract and are wrapped as untrusted.

limit.description: return at most this many items (1-50, default 50)

query.description: name, symbol, address, transaction or block hash, or block number

name: explorer_search
title: Search
